parsed.name: Andor 科学级CCD相机
parsed.description: 用于实验室低光成像、光谱探测和时间分辨采集的制冷科学级CCD相机。该设备支持探测器温控、快门与触发控制、可配置读出速度和增益，并可采集单帧或连续图像数据。
parsed.description_en: A cooled scientific CCD camera for low-light imaging, spectroscopy detection, and time-resolved acquisition in the laboratory. The device supports detector temperature control, shutter and trigger control, configurable readout speeds and gain, and acquisition of single-frame or continuous image data.
